QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_25

question.text: Per the current Section 112A rate (as revised in 2024 for transfers on or after July 23, 2024), long-term capital gains on listed equity shares/equity-oriented mutual fund units exceeding the Rs. 1.25 lakh annual exemption are taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 112A of the Income-tax Act, 1961 was amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 to set the LTCG rate on listed equity (with STT paid) at 12.5% (without indexation) for transfers on or after July 23, 2024, with an annual exemption of Rs. 1.25 lakh, plus applicable surcharge and cess. The Trap: 10% reflects the pre-July-23-2024 rate. 15% and 20% are STCG rates (legacy and current Section 111A respectively), not LTCG. Note: The XIX-A workbook discusses LTCG/STCG characterisation and pass-through taxation generally; it does not state a specific 12.5% LTCG rate, so the figure should always be cross-checked against the latest Income-tax Act position.
